source: Hand-authored: we hold no Mailjet credentials (the municipal installation brings its own Premium sub-account). The request matches app/connectors/mailjet/mailjet.py's send() and Mailjet's documented Send API v3.1 contract (POST /v3.1/send, Basic auth with the API key and secret, a Messages array of From{Email,Name}/To[{Email}]/Subject/TextPart/HTMLPart/ReplyTo{Email}, TrackOpens/TrackClicks taking account_default|disabled|enabled). The response is the documented success shape (Messages[].Status = "success", To[] with MessageUUID/MessageID/MessageHref). Every address is a repo fixture under example.test. MATCH_FIELDS = {Messages} (fields.py), so replay only answers the exact JSON below. Re-record against a real (test) sub-account with scripts/record_cassette.py --connector mailjet --scenario send_ok once one exists, diff-review before committing.

Messages.Subject: Tu turno
Messages.TextPart: Tu turno es el 9 de julio a las 09:00.
Messages.HTMLPart: Tu turno es el 9 de julio a las 09:00.
